title: BetaClaudeTagSettingSources
description: For each setting, the settings level its value in `settings` comes from. Without `include_inherited`, a setting the channel or workspace stores has a source that names the channel or workspace itself, and one it does not store has null, or an empty list for `instructions`. With `include_inherited=true` no member is null: a value that no settings level sets has the source `default`.

instructions.description: Every settings level that contributes text to `instructions`, broadest first, in the order their text is joined. Empty when none does.

reply_mode.description: The settings level `reply_mode` comes from: the channel when it stores one. With `include_inherited=true` and no stored mode it is `default`.
